comparison.objective: Open a disconnect, versus commission and lock a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Actuation of a disconnect mechanism versus hex-key insertion, setscrew loosening, fine collar rotation, counterholding, and retightening.
comparison.success_condition: Disconnect reaches an open state versus repeated dynamically acceptable stops with retained adjustment.
comparison.reason: A shared actuation primitive does not equate the electrical-isolation and damper-tuning abilities. Body and specs are absent.
